Container.Name: StormWatch
Container.Overview: Lightning proximity and NWS severe weather alerts as Home Assistant entities via MQTT auto-discovery. Free data sources by default; no accounts, no API keys. NOT a life-safety system.

Config.Name: MQTT Host
Config.Description: Your Mosquitto broker. Required.

Config.Name: NWS Contact
Config.Description: Sent in the User-Agent header, per NWS policy. Required.

Config.Name: Location
Config.Description: City name, e.g. Asheville, NC. Atlanta, GA is only a placeholder default -- change it to your own city (or leave blank and use Latitude/Longitude instead). Left as Atlanta, GA (or blank) with Latitude/Longitude also blank, StormWatch defaults there and logs a startup warning. Geocoded once and cached to /config/location.json.

Config.Name: Latitude
Config.Description: Decimal degrees, e.g. 34.0234. Optional -- recommended over Location for lightning-radius precision (a city geocode lands on the city center). Overrides Location when both Latitude and Longitude are set.

Config.Name: Longitude
Config.Description: Decimal degrees, e.g. -84.6155. Optional -- recommended over Location for lightning-radius precision (a city geocode lands on the city center). Overrides Location when both Latitude and Longitude are set.

Config.Name: MQTT Port
Config.Description: Your Mosquitto broker port.

Config.Name: MQTT Username
Config.Description: If your broker requires auth.

Config.Name: MQTT Password
Config.Description: If your broker requires auth.

Config.Name: Units
Config.Description: imperial or metric.

Config.Name: Close Radius
Config.Description: In UNITS. Lightning distance that closes the pool -- a strike inside this radius triggers a 'get out of the water' alert.

Config.Name: Watch Radius
Config.Description: In UNITS. Lightning distance for the heads-up watch ring (not pool-closed) -- a strike inside this radius but outside Close Radius is a warning to watch the sky.

Config.Name: All Clear Minutes
Config.Description: Minutes of no activity before signaling all-clear.

Config.Name: Alerts Critical
Config.Description: NWS events that fire a CRITICAL alert -- breaks through Do Not Disturb in Home Assistant. Comma-separated exact NWS event names, e.g. Tornado Warning,Flash Flood Emergency. For full control incl. winter/regex/quiet-hours, edit /config/alerts.yaml -- see docs/ALERT-RULES.md.

Config.Name: Alerts High
Config.Description: NWS events that fire a HIGH alert -- an audible push notification, does not break Do Not Disturb. Comma-separated exact NWS event names, e.g. Severe Thunderstorm Warning,Flash Flood Warning. For full control incl. winter/regex/quiet-hours, edit /config/alerts.yaml -- see docs/ALERT-RULES.md.

Config.Name: Alerts Normal
Config.Description: NWS events that fire a NORMAL alert -- silent, no push sound. Comma-separated exact NWS event names, e.g. Tornado Watch,Severe Thunderstorm Watch. For full control incl. winter/regex/quiet-hours, edit /config/alerts.yaml -- see docs/ALERT-RULES.md.

Config.Name: Quiet Hours
Config.Description: Applies only to rules with quiet_hours: true.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity, e.g. INFO, DEBUG, WARNING.

Config.Name: Xweather Client ID
Config.Description: Optional — premium lightning data. Blank = fully functional free mode. Your own Xweather API client ID.

Config.Name: Xweather Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional — premium lightning data. Blank = fully functional free mode. Your own Xweather API client secret.

Config.Name: Xweather Confirm Radius
Config.Description: Optional — premium lightning data. Blank = fully functional free mode. In UNITS. Only confirm strikes already this close.

Config.Name: Xweather Monthly Call Limit
Config.Description: Optional — premium lightning data. Blank = fully functional free mode. Kept under the free allowance on purpose.

Config.Name: Xweather Min Call Interval
Config.Description: Optional — premium lightning data. Blank = fully functional free mode. Seconds between Xweather API calls.

Config.Name: Blitzortung MQTT Host
Config.Description: Blitzortung community lightning network relay. See design doc §4.1.1 before changing.

Config.Name: Blitzortung Enabled
Config.Description: true or false. Disable to run NWS alerts only.

Config.Name: NWS Enabled
Config.Description: Non-US users turn this off.

Config.Name: NWS Poll Seconds
Config.Description: Floor of 30 enforced.

Config.Name: NWS API Base
Config.Description: Testing/override; rarely changed. NWS API base URL.

Config.Name: Config Dir
Config.Description: Path to persistent storage for alert rules and state.

Config.Name: Rain Enabled
Config.Description: Rainfall feature — arriving in this build.

Config.Name: Rain Forecast Poll Seconds
Config.Description: Rainfall feature — arriving in this build. Seconds between forecast updates.

Config.Name: Rain Obs Poll Seconds
Config.Description: Rainfall feature — arriving in this build. Seconds between observation updates.

Config.Name: Discovery Prefix
Config.Description: Home Assistant MQTT discovery prefix.

Config.Name: Device Name
Config.Description: Change if running multiple instances.

Config.Name: Strike Map Window Minutes
Config.Description: Minutes of strike history retained for the lightning strike map (sensor.stormwatch_lightning_strikes geojson attribute). Floored at 1.

Config.Name: Healthz Port
Config.Description: Optional. JSON status endpoint at /healthz: source connectivity, current state, quota usage, config validity.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent storage for StormWatch state and configuration.
